translations.title: Java Developer
translations.description:
As a leading bank in the market, we keep up with modern technological challenges and methodologies through in-house development, introduce innovations, and are constantly one step ahead.

We have a vacancy for an experienced product designer in the Electronic Banking Services Department of the Bank of Georgia.

We are looking for an experienced Product Designer who will work with a multidisciplinary team (Product Owners, Analysts, Developers, Scrum Masters, UX Researchers, and UX Copywriters) to create products with the best user experience using the Agile project management methodology.
activities: Creating a user-centric experience throughout the product lifecycle;
Product analysis and generation of tailored initiatives;
Identifying research needs with the team, analyzing research findings and user feedback, and continuously improving the product based on it;
Preparation of high and low fidelity wireframes and prototypes;
Development of design system library components and rules for their use.
importantPoints: Attention to detail and attention to detail;
Desire to work in a team full of energy and motivation;
Effective communication skills.
requirements: At least 2 years of experience working as a product designer;
Experience in developing complex mobile and web applications;
Experience working on a design system;
Experience using Figma;
Experience in creating wireframes;
Minimum knowledge of PS, AI;
Knowledge of the basics of UX research. Become part of the Bank of Georgia team so you don't stop and can fully utilize your potential.
